product_from_film: Tapcaps Creatures are presented as collectible character objects that also fit onto keyboard keys.

lessons.keep: Use a clear physical product action to motivate a change into a fictional world.
lessons.avoid: Avoid leaving the real product role and brand hidden for most of a story-led film.
lessons.open: Exact keycap functions, compatibility, materials, animation details between samples and all sound properties remain unverified.
try: For Tin, let a real button press lead into a short visual metaphor, then return to the completed output.
Show the product name before the story expands, and end with a practical use close-up beside the buying prompt.
